Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff: proposed plan & next steps

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your POC kicked off smoothly:

- Goal: Validate latency and cost profile for your document ingestion + retrieval use case (search + summarization) at ~10k monthly active users.
- Success criteria: median generation latency <400ms for 512-token outputs, embedding quality meeting your relevance threshold, and estimated token/unit cost within your target.
- Proposed POC scope (2 weeks): 1) environment setup & sample ingestion, 2) baseline run + tuning, 3) short evaluation run & sync to review results.

Action items: 
1) Can you confirm kickoff owners and an initial environment window? We suggested the week of July 6 — ideally July 6 or 7 for a 60-min kickoff.
2) We need a test S3 bucket (or staging source) + a service account key with read access. If there are security constraints, we can run a hosted staging option.
3) Please review the attached POC runbook and draft SOW — we can adjust scope after your review.

Attachments: [Attachment: POC-runbook.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)], [Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (docx, 120KB)]

If the July 6 window isn't realistic, let me know dates that work and we'll adapt. Happy to keep this lightweight — we can also do a 30-min enablement instead of a full kickoff if you prefer.

Thanks,
Marissa

Redwood Inference
